focus: A Mathematical Theory of Communication, Section 12 (Entropy of a Discrete Channel with Noise / equivocation) is too broad, so focus only on the binary symmetric channel example: explain the capacity C = 1 - H(p) of a binary symmetric channel with crossover probability p. Let the learner change p and the input distribution, show the mutual information, the equivocation, and the capacity curve. Check that capacity is 1 bit at p = 0 and 0 bits at p = 0.5.
